title: GitHub Integration and Branching
summary: Connect Fabric workspaces to GitHub safely, run GitHub Flow with feature workspaces, harden the repository with rulesets, and automate deployment with service principals and OIDC.
audience: Platform leads, DevOps and data engineers, Fabric workspace admins, GitHub organization owners

pages.title: Overview and ALM map
pages.description: What Fabric Git integration with GitHub gives you, when to use it, the end-to-end change flow and how the pages of this playbook fit together.

pages.title: Prerequisites and authentication
pages.description: Tenant settings, capacity, workspace and GitHub permissions, token types for the Git connection, GitHub Enterprise Cloud support and the two-tier identity model.

pages.title: Repository and workspace layout
pages.description: How workspace items map to repository folders, item folder anatomy, one repository versus many, recommended layout and the limits that shape it.

pages.title: Connecting safely
pages.description: Preflight safeguards, the first-sync decision, step-by-step connection of each workspace, the baseline commit and the folder-change hazard.

pages.title: Sync model and supported items
pages.description: Commit, update, undo and conflict handling, branch operations, known quirks, how to read the supported-item list and the general limitations.

pages.title: GitHub Flow for Fabric
pages.description: Main as source of truth, feature branches, branch-out workspaces, why data is not copied, the pull request process and cleanup.

pages.title: Access model and repository hardening
pages.description: Teams, roles and least privilege, Entra ID and SSO, rulesets versus branch protection, the recommended main ruleset and optional scanning.

pages.title: Service principals and Actions
pages.description: Service principal setup, secret scopes, environments with required reviewers, OIDC federation, GitHub Actions workflows and fabric-cicd.

pages.title: Operations, rollback and checklist
pages.description: The unified secure ALM view, auditing, troubleshooting, rollback with git revert or reset, restoring in Fabric and the readiness checklist.
